scope: Exploratory description of 100 preview records (a hash-ranked sample, not a prevalence estimate) in one named embedding space (SigLIP2 image recipe) and one reference set. It shows how the tools expose structure; it is not an attack-detection result, a model accuracy claim, or evidence about unseen attacks.
limits: Records are single images; the preview mixes sources, splits and attacks; the outlier score is relative to this 100-image reference set only.
